Name: Share Experience
Author: gggl634624654567
Description:
Share the additional experience gained from skills that have already reached their full level with skills that have not yet reached their full level, in order to unlock the Mastery Cave earlier. (Added configuration of conversion rate percentage in v0.0.2)

The in-game clock every 10 minutes checks and shares the additional experience gained from skills already reached level 10 with skills that have not yet reached level 10, until all skills reach level 10.
If this MOD is used on an existing saved files, it will also share the additional experience accumulated from previous of full level skills.(Added configuration of ignore the accumulated experience in save file before in v0.0.5)

For example, when a player's fishing skill reaches level 10 and the other four skills have not yet reached level 10, the experience gained from fishing will be divided equally among the other four skills.

Compatibility:
If using UI Info Suite 2 MOD simultaneously, Please use UI Info Suite 2 MOD v2.3.2 or above version.

[s]v0.0.3 added additional skills configuration:[/s]
[s]Allow additional skills added in some MODs to share experiences, set additional MOD skill IDs in the GMCM configuration item, separated by spaces, such as: 5 6 7. (or set [5,6,7] if directly modify the configuration file)[/s]
[s]Only MODs which based on the Farmer.experiencePoints extension in the source code are supported, such as Luck Skill (skill ID is 5). Enter '--sp p' in the SMAPI command line to view available skill IDs.[/s]
[s]Note: If other additional skill MODs are not used, please do not set the value of this configuration item, otherwise it may lead to the loss of Mastery Experience.
[/s]
If luck skill MOD are used, you can allow the luck skill share experiences in configuration.

v0.0.6 added SpaceCore Skills configuration:
For custom skills based on SpaceCore MOD, they will get the experience shared by other Lv10 vanilla skills.
(Due to the API limit of SpaceCore MOD, can not obtain the exact experience for each level of custom skills. So Lv10 skills which based on SpaceCore MOD will not share their experience to other skills.)

Command line tools:
Enter --sp in the SMAPI command line to view available commands; Enter '--sp p' to view the player's experience values for each skill;
